page.layout: One page of text, single column; no margin notes. Signature and catchword line at the foot.

main_text.head: NEC NON Amplissimo, Nobilissimo, Spectatissimo Viro Dn. JOH. RODOLPHO WURSTEMBERGERO, in Illustrissimâ Bernensi Republicâ quoad Ditionem Romanam Quaestori meritissimo, gravissimo, olim ejusdem Reipubl: Tribuno plebis consultissimo Hospiti & Euergetae suo summâ reverentiâ nullo non tempore prosequendo.

UT ET Reverendo ac Doctrinæ & pietatis laude conspicuo Viro Dn. SEBASTIANO HOEGGERO, Ecclesiæ Sangallensis Pastori fidissimo, Gymnasij quondam Rectori spectatissimo, Parenti suo omni Filiali obsequio colendo.

p.i: Hasce Studiorum suorum Theologicorum primitias degustandas humilime & officiosissime offert

page.notes: Title page-like text with large mixed-type headings; the page number is not printed. Show-through from the reverse side is present in the background and was ignored. The "UT ET" heading reads "Ut Er" in the scan and is transcribed as printed in small capitals; uncertain.
